in_hebrew.name: עִדָלָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A Hebrew name derived from the root word עדל (idl) which means 'mighty' or 'strong'. The feminine form עִדָלָה (Idalla) means 'mighty woman' or 'strong lady'.

in_greek.name: Ιδάλλα
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word ίδαλλος (Idallos) which means 'adornment' or 'decoration'. The feminine form Ιδάλλα (Idalla) could possibly mean 'adorned woman' or 'decorated lady'.
